opening.argument: The title presents a Forsage-related withdrawal as something that can happen “in a Heartbeat,” while the narration supplies a step-by-step process for obtaining money. The speaker directs viewers to copy an address, apply for and confirm a withdrawal, and then convert BUSD into WRX before selling the full amount; the supplied screens show the BUSD-to-WRX conversion and a WRX sale with an INR total and an order placed. The speaker also says, “I am selling 100%” and taking “this profit point,” presenting the result as profit. The stated $92 and later ₹6,527 payments place money participation within this promoted flow, although the recipients, transaction authenticity, and viewer outcomes are not established.
